criticalPath.explanation: Native approval still constrains release effects, not local qualification or reviewed Git delivery. Qualification can expose the smallest justified adapter or external-evidence handoff; it does not preauthorize implementation. Delivery closes an independent AC7/AC8 gap. Neither branch depends on full sprint acceptance or unlocks the unchanged denial.
criticalPath.estimates: Task minutes are scheduling estimates, not limits. Native/cloud duration remains unknown.

governance.gitReconciliationOwner: Developer assigned IP-C1-COLLECTION-SEAMS for its new qualification/test/index paths; Developer assigned IP-C1-REVIEWED-REF-DELIVERY for the two exact reviewed remote refs.
governance.ownership: Qualification owns only its new document, focused fixtures and additive index refresh. Delivery owns no source paths and never pushes new qualification/planning ancestry. application-git-integration serializes commits/push inspections through original reviews; it is not a whole implementation dependency.
governance.git: Stay on the established feature branch. Inspect status/staging; commit only owned paths using git commit --only. Preserve unowned index/specification edits, locks and dirty source. Reconcile task commits by feature ancestry; any retained unmerged task branch needs task, branch, commits and abandonment reason recorded in a feature-branch commit. No force, branch switching, reset, stash or moving-HEAD push.
governance.integration: No runtime join is introduced. Qualification owner performs its own focused fixture/document/index integration before original review, with exact commit/results handoff. Delivery consumes only earlier accepted refs. A justified runtime adapter needs a subsequent original Architect/Scrum assignment and affected E2E qualification; do not construct it implicitly.
governance.preservedBoundary: No native denial retry/bypass, credential retrieval, infrastructure/permission mutation, external upload, production profile or held/UNKNOWN replay. COMMON rollback provenance remains WAIVED, never PASS. Original package/source/version/trusted-host/effect gates and actual cloud completion remain mandatory. All three sprints remain partial.

consumes: Application-owned factories and read-only matching pinned SDK source

acceptanceCriteria: Map manifest, cumulative immutable operation transitions, MAF checkpoints, independent create/send/stop accounting and model-history provenance to existing aggregate fields. Identify exact public methods/constructors, pinned source/version, scope provenance, pagination/completeness and consistency boundaries.

Qualify independent boundary-to-operation accounting rather than counting journal intentions, deduplicating captured events or treating diagnostic aliases/timing as identity. Name every unavailable association explicitly.

Execute synthetic fixtures at claimed public serialization/attachment seams for immutable retention, scoped checkpoint association and missing/duplicate/cross-scope rejection. Do not copy the aggregate validator, access real credentials/network or patch SDK internals.

Provide the smallest feasible adapter contract or actionable unsupported findings with minimal external evidence needed. Negative findings may complete qualification but never satisfy actual live comparisons or authorize unqualified hooks.

Preserve accepted companion/validator/runtime, machine stdout, known-response recovery and held/UNKNOWN effects. Run focused fixtures and documented application/repository checks with existing absolute Python and explicit selected-lab root. Install dependencies only after manifest change or missing-tool failure.
Integrate only owned document/tests/index paths on the feature branch, preserve unowned overlays and retain exact commit/test provenance for original Architect/Critic review.
tasks.doneWhen: A source-pinned collection feasibility matrix and passing offline fixtures support every claimed public seam, exact unsupported comparisons remain explicit, and an exact-commit handoff is ready for original Architect/Critic review; actionable negative findings can complete only this qualification.
exclusions: No network, credential acquisition, platform log retrieval, live collection, send/stop/retry or publication.
No new evidence schema, terminal/parser API, SDK private patch, runtime adapter, diagnostic identity disclosure or generic evidence ledger.
No duplicate accepted SDK inventory, companion rewrite or waiver of real-service criteria.
tasks.handoff: Reviewed feature commit, pinned public seam references, focused/documented commands and results, supported adapter contract or exact negative findings to original Architect/Scrum Master and original E2E/DevOps evidence owners. Reconcile owned commits before handoff; retain branch/commit/reason accounting for any unmerged work.
